intro: I took this to the room and brought in the Explainer Systematist, the Y2K Interface Futurist, the Data Storyteller, the Ink-Wash Animator from the studio roster. Here's where they agree, where they split, and what I'd do.

proposals.headline: Text earns its place in 1.5 s — hierarchy first, ornament second, never the reverse.

moves.text: Couple name enters at frame 1, ease-out over 18 frames (0.3 s at 60 fps), scale 96→100%, opacity 0→100%; kerning holds; no motion until fully legible.
moves.where: frames 1–18 / ease-out cubic / on the downbeat

moves.text: Date and venue line staggers in 6 frames after name settles (frame 24), same ease-out 18 frames, 14 px smaller — hierarchy enforced by arrival order, not size alone.
moves.where: frames 24–42 / ease-out cubic / beat 2

moves.text: RSVP call-to-action fades in last at frame 72 (1.2 s), opacity 0→100% over 12 frames — readable window opens at 1.2 s, well inside the 1.5 s spec.
moves.where: frames 72–84 / ease-out cubic / beat 4

moves.text: Idle: no text moves more than 1 px vertically in the parallax loop; type layer is locked to the deepest parallax depth so it never drifts against its own baseline.
moves.where: idle / linear / ±1 px / 0 motion blur

moves.text: Reduced-motion: all text appears at full opacity at frame 0 with a single 6-frame ease-out fade — no translate, no scale, readable at frame 1.
moves.where: frames 0–6 / ease-out cubic / immediate

proposals.headline: The botanical plate breathes; negative space is the composition, not the background.

moves.text: Generated art plate reveals as an ink-bleed procedural: pigment diffuses outward from centre over 90 frames (1.5 s), alpha driven by a reaction-diffusion mask — edges soft, never hard-outlined.
moves.where: frames 0–90 / ease-in-out / reaction-diffusion, 24-fps on-2 cadence baked to 60 fps

moves.text: Botanical cut-outs (2–4 layers) enter on staggered scroll-like horizontal drifts: each travels 8 px right-to-left over 48 frames, ease-in-out, then rests — referencing the horizontal scroll of a hand-held painting.
moves.where: frames 18–66 staggered 12 frames apart / ease-in-out / 8 px horizontal

moves.text: Idle loop: botanical layers drift ±3 px vertically over 300 frames (5 s), linear, looping — breath, not bounce; no overshoot.
moves.where: idle / linear / ±3 px / 5 s period

moves.text: Tilt parallax: deepest botanical layer moves 6 px max at full tilt (±30°), mid layer 3 px, text layer 0 px — emptiness in the centre preserved regardless of device angle.
moves.where: tilt / linear mapping / 6 px max / 3 px mid / 0 px text

moves.text: Reduced-motion: plate appears at full opacity frame 0, botanicals static — negative space reads immediately, no motion required for the composition to feel complete.
moves.where: frame 0 / instant / no translate

proposals.headline: The foil-catch must live inside the painted plate — matched grain, matched blur, no floating CG.

moves.text: WebGL foil layer samples device tilt via DeviceOrientation API and applies a specular highlight ramp (warm gold at 0°, cool silver at 30°) rendered at 8.3 ms motion blur (half-frame at 60 fps, matching the 180° shutter reference) — never sharper than the plate.
moves.where: idle/tilt layer / 8.3 ms blur / WebGL / real-time

moves.text: Grain structure: procedural film grain at 2–3% luminance noise, seeded per frame, applied over the composite as the topmost WebGL pass — matches the watercolour texture so the foil does not appear cleaner than the paper.
moves.where: all frames / grain pass / 2–3% luminance / WebGL top layer

moves.text: Black point: the generated art plate is linearised to a minimum luminance of 8/255 (not pure black) so the candlelight palette never clips to video black and the foil highlight reads against it.
moves.where: colour pass / black point 8/255 / applied at composite stage

moves.text: Envelope seal edge: the wax-seal cut-out has a 4 px inner-shadow (multiply blend, 40% opacity) baked into the mask so the lift off the plate reads as physical depth without a separate shadow layer.
moves.where: seal layer / 4 px inner-shadow / multiply / static

moves.text: Reduced-motion: grain and foil shader remain live (they are cheap and framerate-independent); only translate and scale animations are suppressed — the surface still feels material.
moves.where: reduced-motion / shader on / translate off

proposals.headline: Every surface is a rule, not a baked clip — the foil, the botanicals and the particles answer to tilt and time in real time.

moves.text: Botanical art plate is a seeded Perlin-flow field: each run seeds from the event date integer so every guest sees an identical but procedurally generated composition — not a static PNG.
moves.where: frame 0 / GLSL / seeded by date integer / deterministic per event

moves.text: Foil-catch is a real-time anisotropic specular GLSL shader driven by DeviceOrientation beta/gamma — highlight position is computed per frame, never pre-rendered; tilt 0→30° maps highlight x from 15%→85% of card width.
moves.where: idle/tilt / GLSL anisotropic / 0–30° → 15–85% x / real-time

moves.text: RSVP 'yes' particle burst: a GPU particle system emits 120 gold fleck particles from the seal centre, each with randomised velocity (speed 40–80 px/s), drag 0.92 per frame, lifetime 60 frames — system rule, not a baked sprite sheet.
moves.where: RSVP yes / GPU particles / 120 count / 60-frame lifetime / drag 0.92

moves.text: Idle candle-flicker: a 1D simplex noise function modulates the warm-light WebGL mask intensity ±8% luminance at 0.3–0.7 Hz, seeded to wall-clock time — never repeats in the same session.
moves.where: idle / simplex noise / ±8% luminance / 0.3–0.7 Hz / real-time

moves.text: Reduced-motion: particle system emits 0 particles; noise modulation frozen at its seed value; foil shader still responds to tilt (it is not animation, it is physics).
moves.where: reduced-motion / particles off / noise frozen / foil shader on

proposals.headline: The reveal earns its scale: darkness first, then candlelight, then the names — the beat before the moment is everything.

moves.text: Entrance opens on 80% luminance vignette (the plate is dark at edges); vignette eases out from 80→0% over 30 frames (0.5 s), ease-out cubic — the eye is pulled inward before text arrives.
moves.where: frames 0–30 / ease-out cubic / vignette 80→0%

moves.text: Candlelight warm-light mask (WebGL) blooms from the lower-third over frames 12–48, radius 40→180 px, ease-out — it precedes the text by 6 frames so light greets the words.
moves.where: frames 12–48 / ease-out / radius 40→180 px / warm gold 2700 K

moves.text: Envelope seal sits in frame at full scale from frame 0 but is revealed by the vignette lift — no separate entrance animation needed; the light does the reveal.
moves.where: frames 0–30 / revealed by vignette / no scale animation

moves.text: Idle: candlelight mask centre drifts ±4 px on a 7 s sinusoidal loop, linear — slow enough to read as heat, fast enough to feel alive.
moves.where: idle / sinusoidal / ±4 px / 7 s period / linear

moves.text: Reduced-motion: vignette held at 0% from frame 0; candlelight mask at its mid-bloom radius (110 px) static — the depth reads from light alone, no motion required.
moves.where: reduced-motion / vignette 0% / mask static 110 px

tensions: INK_WASH demands the botanical cut-outs drift only 8 px horizontally on entrance and rest in stillness, protecting the negative space as composition; Y2K (not formally proposing here but present in the room) pushes back that the emerald-deco palette and foil-catch demand a glossy specular overshoot arrival — INK_WASH holds that an overshoot on a botanical element breaks the suggestion of a hand-drawn brush and turns the painting into a gadget; the council sides with INK_WASH on the botanicals and confines all overshoot energy exclusively to the RSVP 'yes' particle burst, where celebration earns the exuberance.

GENERATIVE insists the foil shader must remain live under reduced-motion because it responds to physics (tilt), not to a timeline; KINETIC initially objects that any movement risks distraction from text readability in the 1.5 s window; resolved by confirming the foil shader has zero effect on text-layer luminance or position and operates only on the WebGL mask beneath the type, so readability is never compromised.

plan.text: Entrance phase 1 — vignette lifts and candlelight blooms before any text: vignette eases from 80→0% and warm-light mask expands 40→180 px, both ease-out cubic.
Entrance phase 2 — botanical plate diffuses in via reaction-diffusion alpha mask, ink-bleed from centre, edges soft, no hard outline.

Entrance phase 3 — couple name eases in scale 96→100% opacity 0→100% over 18 frames, then date/venue staggers 6 frames later over 18 frames, then RSVP CTA at frame 72 over 12 frames; all text readable by frame 84 (1.4 s).
plan.where: frames 18–84 / ease-out cubic / KINETIC / hierarchy: name → date → CTA

plan.text: Idle loop — botanicals drift ±3 px vertical over 5 s linear; candlelight mask drifts ±4 px on 7 s sinusoid; foil shader modulates ±8% luminance via simplex noise 0.3–0.7 Hz; text locked to 0 px drift.
plan.where: idle / linear + sinusoidal + simplex / GENERATIVE + CINEMATIC + KINETIC

plan.text: Tilt parallax — DeviceOrientation beta/gamma: deep botanical layer ±6 px, mid layer ±3 px, text layer 0 px; foil highlight x maps 15–85% of card width across 0–30° tilt; all at 8.3 ms motion blur.
plan.where: tilt / linear mapping / COMPOSITOR blur spec / GENERATIVE shader

plan.text: Interactive moment — on tap/hover of envelope seal: wax seal scales 100→96% (6 frames ease-in anticipation), then lifts 100→108% and rotates 0→−4° over 18 frames ease-out overshoot; foil-catch highlight sweeps left-to-right across the card over 24 frames ease-in-out; gold fleck particles (GPU, 120 count, 60-frame lifetime, drag 0.92) burst from seal centre.
plan.where: tap event / anticipation 6 f ease-in / lift 18 f ease-out overshoot / foil sweep 24 f / particles 60 f / CHARACTER + GENERATIVE + COMPOSITOR

plan.text: RSVP 'yes' celebration — seal dissolves via ink-bleed alpha (reaction-diffusion, 30 frames), text 'See you there' fades in ease-out 18 frames at frame 30, particle system runs its 60-frame lifetime, candlelight mask blooms to 240 px over 24 frames then settles back to 180 px over 60 frames.
plan.where: RSVP yes / frames 0–90 post-tap / INK_WASH + GENERATIVE + CINEMATIC

plan.text: Reduced-motion — plate and text at full opacity frame 0 (6-frame ease-out fade only); all translate/scale animations suppressed; grain and foil shader live; noise frozen at seed; particles emit 0; candlelight mask static at 110 px; composition reads as finished illustration at frame 0.

summary: The entrance is a candlelit unveiling, not a sequence of entrances: light and ink arrive together in the first 0.5 s, the plate diffuses into being by 1.5 s, and the names settle into readable hierarchy by 1.4 s — well inside the spec. Nothing overshoots except the RSVP celebration, where exuberance is earned. The idle state is breath, not animation: three independent slow drifts (botanical, candlelight, foil noise) at different periods so the card never feels baked. Tilt is physics — the foil shader answers the room, not a keyframe. The interactive moment uses anticipation and overshoot on the seal lift because CHARACTER demanded weight, and the foil sweep is composited at 8.3 ms blur so it sits inside the painted plate rather than floating above it. Reduced-motion is a finished illustration at frame 0: grain and foil shader remain live because they are material, not animation, and the composition — negative space, candlelight, names — reads without a single translate. The Y2K gloss impulse is channelled entirely into the foil-catch shader, where it belongs; the botanicals are never gadgets.
